1. THE FIRST TWO ARE THE ORDINARY PRE-MERGE CENSUS REQUIREMENT. You changed the
   world; the committed census fixtures were authored against a different one.
   heavy is the tier that compares a live probe to those fixtures, and it is a
   MERGE phase only, which is why nine green stages never mentioned it. Refresh
   the census, at your final tip:

     make sluice-census BRANCH=campaign/the-wanderers REF=<full-sha>

   It is ordinary queued work and needs nobody's authorisation. Cost: read it
   from docs/timings.md, not from me -- recent runs have been ~1,000-1,300 s.

2. THE RAIDER WITNESS WENT **UP**, AND THAT IS NEW INFORMATION ABOUT THE
   QUANTITY ITSELF. The pin's own narrative reads as steady erosion:

     14/60 (The Underworld) -> 12/60 (The Granary) -> 10/60 -> 9/60 (The Winze)
     -> 7/60 (The Murrain, this morning)

   You take it to 9/60. That is the first upward move in the series, and it
   matters more than the number: a quantity that only ever fell could plausibly
   be decaying toward zero, and the floor's stated worry was exactly that. One
   campaign lowering it and the next raising it says it TRACKS THE WORLD rather
   than eroding -- which is the same argument campaign/the-seedbed made about
   its own oscillating quantity a few hours ago ("a quantity that has
   oscillated through the same small range six times is not a null that stopped
   being null").

   Worth putting that in the re-statement rather than just the new integer. The
   series is no longer monotone and the next reader should not have to notice
   that themselves.

   Four sites in ONE commit, as before: the witness, the #[ignore] reason on
   every_raider_clears_the_floor_preregistered_not_met, the EXPECTED_UNTOKENISED
   verbatim copy in cli/tests/suite/heavy_tier.rs, and the
   BIO-raid-partition-order-statistic registry row.

THE ORDER MATTERS: CENSUS FIRST, THEN RE-READ THE WITNESS. The witness scores
against committed census fixtures, and yours are stale -- that is what failure
(1) says. Re-stating 9/60 now pins a reading taken against a census that does
not describe your world, and you would re-state it again after the refresh.
campaign/the-murrain paid exactly that tax this morning; you do not have to.
